editions.title: melon desktop
editions.blurb: KDE Plasma on Wayland. A live session you can try first, and the graphical installer. This is the one most people want.
editions.desc: KDE Plasma on Wayland, live session and graphical installer.

editions.title: melon console
editions.blurb: No desktop: a small system with a quick text installer, for servers, tinkerers and virtual machines.
editions.desc: No desktop, with a quick text installer.

editions.title: melon 32-bit desktop
editions.blurb: LXQt on Wayland for old netbooks and 32-bit laptops, with the same installers. Tested in QEMU on an emulated Atom N270 with 2 GB; not yet tried on a real netbook.
editions.desc: LXQt on Wayland for old netbooks and 32-bit laptops, live session and graphical installer. Tested in QEMU only so far.

editions.title: melon 32-bit console
editions.blurb: No desktop, for 32-bit machines, with the quick text installer. Tested in QEMU only so far.
editions.desc: No desktop, for 32-bit machines, with the quick text installer. Tested in QEMU only so far.

x86.title: melon 32-bit
x86.blurb: For old netbooks and 32-bit laptops: LXQt on Wayland, with the same installers. Not published yet.
x86.desc: For old netbooks and 32-bit laptops. Not published yet.
